## Summary

Describe the problem, the change, and its operator impact.

## Evidence and safety checklist

- [ ] Tests: I added or updated focused tests and ran the relevant tests.
- [ ] Documentation: I updated English and Italian (EN/IT) product documentation where supported behavior changed.
- [ ] Secrets: This pull request contains no credentials, tokens, private keys, private paths, catalog databases, unsanitized logs, or HPE support tickets.
- [ ] Backward compatibility: I assessed compatibility for existing users, commands, and persisted state.
- [ ] Catalog schema: I assessed catalog-schema compatibility, migration, and recovery impact.
- [ ] Privileged operations: I assessed the effect on privileged Windows services and permissions.
- [ ] Destructive tape operation: I assessed the effect on destructive tape operations and documented safeguards.
- [ ] Release-note impact: I identified any release-note or upgrade guidance required.

## Test evidence

List the commands run and their results. State any tests that could not run and why.
